# Distinction Lab

> Distinction Lab is a managed data annotation and labeling company. We run the data work behind AI as a dedicated team, so AI builders can focus on the model.

## What we do
- Data annotation and labeling (images, video, text, audio)
- RLHF and LLM data
- Model evaluation
- Data curation
- Quality assurance (dual-layer review, 98%+ accuracy, free rework)
- Managed data teams

## Pricing (bounding box annotation, for reference)
Free trial 100 items $0; Basic 1,000 boxes $25; Standard 10,000 boxes $200; Premium 100,000 boxes $1,850; Enterprise 500,000 boxes $9,250. Other annotation types are quoted per project.
